title: Ivo and the Room
author: Mirabel Hartwell
blurb: Bram Brightwater, a hospice nurse who hears the dying count backwards, has spent seven years telling themselves the noises have explanations. But when the village's church bell rings although the bell was melted down in 1911, he discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. To get through this, he must learn the song's last verse without singing along before the last resident signs the papers.
style: richly descriptive with an intimate third-person narration
